items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kenny Joe Clark? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. It was no way -- it always ended up to six or seven, nine or ten.

ctx.x: Yeah, with Nick Fenton and Thelonious and the drummer was Harold West sometimes and sometimes it was someone else. Just four pieces.
Yeah. It was no way -- it always ended up to six or seven, nine or ten.
